description: A living room reading nook corner photographed in a warm square format with soft afternoon light. The corner window at the upper left allows soft warm afternoon light to pour in, partially obscured by sheer curtains just outside the frame. A natural jute or sisal rug covers the floor area. Camera at seated eye-level, normal lens, three-quarter corner composition angled to show both the side table and the armchair, level pitch.
